bio.text: Stefany Shaheen, a former Portsmouth city councilor and the daughter of U.S. Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, won the Democratic nomination for New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District in the September 8, 2026 primary.
She will face Republican Anthony DiLorenzo in the November 3 general election.
According to her campaign website, she co-founded the company Good Measures, has chaired the Portsmouth Police Commission, is the author of the book Elle & Coach, and lives in Portsmouth.
According to her campaign website, she is an alumna of MIT's Sloan School of Management and Harvard's Kennedy School of Government and a graduate of Fairfield University.

sources.title: Shaheen defeats Sullivan to win Democratic nomination in 1st Congressional District
